question: Estimate the adoption of Made-in-India payment apps (BHIM, Paytm UPI, NPCI's own) over Google Pay/PhonePe in coming years.
idealClarificationQuestions: Market share by transaction value or volume? Volume.
Made-in-India = Indian-owned + India-headquartered (Paytm, BHIM, MobiKwik, Cred, Bhim Aadhaar)? Yes.
Foreign apps with India ops = Google Pay, PhonePe (technically Indian but Walmart-owned), Amazon Pay? PhonePe debatable; treat PhonePe as Indian-headquartered.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Track current shares + regulatory and policy push for Made-in-India.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: UPI market share by volume (mid-2026): PhonePe ~47%, Google Pay ~36%, Paytm ~9%, others (BHIM, Cred, Amazon Pay, Slice, MobiKwik) ~8%.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: If 'Made-in-India' = Paytm + BHIM + Cred + MobiKwik + Slice + Amazon Pay UPI ≈ 17% currently. PhonePe technically has Indian HQ but US parent (Walmart-owned, until full IPO completion).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Projected 3-year shift: PhonePe + Google Pay capped; Paytm rebound (post-RBI lifting curbs), BHIM push: Made-in-India (excluding PhonePe) reaches ~25-28%.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Note answer is sensitive to whether PhonePe is classified as Indian — flag this.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: PhonePe ~47%, Google Pay ~36%, Paytm ~9%, others (BHIM, Cred, Amazon Pay, Slice, MobiKwik) ~8%.
NPCI's volume cap regulation (no single app >30% by Dec 2026) — forces redistribution; Bharat-first sentiment; UPI Lite default in BHIM.
PhonePe + Google Pay capped; Paytm rebound (post-RBI lifting curbs), BHIM push: Made-in-India (excluding PhonePe) reaches ~25-28%.

calculationFlow: UPI market share by volume (mid-2026): PhonePe ~47%, Google Pay ~36%, Paytm ~9%, others (BHIM, Cred, Amazon Pay, Slice, MobiKwik) ~8%.
If 'Made-in-India' = Paytm + BHIM + Cred + MobiKwik + Slice + Amazon Pay UPI ≈ 17% currently. PhonePe technically has Indian HQ but US parent (Walmart-owned, until full IPO completion).
Projected 3-year shift: PhonePe + Google Pay capped; Paytm rebound (post-RBI lifting curbs), BHIM push: Made-in-India (excluding PhonePe) reaches ~25-28%.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Projected 3-year shift: PhonePe + Google Pay capped; Paytm rebound (post-RBI lifting curbs), BHIM push: Made-in-India (excluding PhonePe) reaches ~25-28%.
